fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects execution of GfxDownloadWrapper.exe with a URL as an argument to download file.
fields.name: Arbitrary File Download Via GfxDownloadWrapper.EXE
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\GfxDownloadWrapper.exe" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "http://" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "https://")) and (not tgt.process.cmdline contains "https://gameplayapi.intel.com/")))
